description: Extends Microsoft QuickGrid with column resizing, drag-and-drop reordering, a column chooser, column pinning,multi-column sorting, aggregation,pivoting, row groupingCSV/Excel/PDF export, row context menu (view/edit/delete), and state management (localStorage persistence and developer preference API).
releaseNotes:
# Release Notes

## v1.11.0
- Added **Pivoting**. Set `EnablePivoting` to show the pivot panel, then build the summary with `PivotGridBuilder`. Row fields stay as rows, column-field values become headers, and value fields use Sum, Count, Average, Min, or Max.

## v1.10.0
- Added **Aggregation** on grouped rows. Each entry in `Aggregates` sums one field into one column. Group rows show that total. `GroupTotalRow` and `GrandTotalRow` add optional bottom total rows.

## v1.9.0
- Added **Row Grouping**. Set `EnableGrouping` to show the Group toolbar, then build the display rows with `GroupedGridBuilder` and render them with `GroupedGridRowView`. Supports multi-level grouping, expand/collapse, default expand depth, object keys, date and custom hierarchies, blank groups, unbalanced rows, and hiding single-child parents.

## v1.8.0
- Added a **row right-click menu** (`EnableRowContextMenu`). Right-click a data row to view, edit, or delete it. The popup shows the same column names as the grid. Save runs your `OnRowEdit` method. Delete runs your `OnRowDelete` method. This menu is off unless you turn it on, so existing grids stay the same.

## v1.7.0
- Added **inline cell edit on data-row double-click** (`EnableInlineEdit`, `OnRowDoubleClick`, `OnCellValueChanged`). Double-click a data cell to type a new value; headers are not editable. Persist the change in the host callback.
- Added **Row Double-Click Events** (`OnRowDoubleClick`, `GridRowDoubleClickEventArgs`) so hosts can open details, edit, a modal, or run custom logic when a data row is double-clicked. Opt-in via the callback; existing grids are unchanged when it is not set.

## v1.6.0
- Added **Column Pinning** (`EnableColumnPinning`, `PinnedColumns`, `OnPinnedColumnsChanged`) so users can freeze one or more columns on the left during horizontal scrolling. A pinned header stays in place when that column is sorted, and pin offsets use sticky positioning so the header lines up with its cells. Pin state persists via `QuickGridPreference.PinnedColumns`. **Reset** restores the default column layout, pinning, sort, grouping, and formatting without a page refresh.

## V1.5.0
- Added **Multi-Column Sorting** so users can sort by more than one column at a time, with numbered badges on headers to show sort order. The sort choices are remembered on reload, and single-column sorting still works as before.

## v1.4.1
-Updated Release Note to NuGet package.
 
## v1.4.0
- Added **Text Alignment** editor inside the Format modal (`GridAlignment`, `OnGridAlignmentChanged`) for aligning all column headers and body cells (Left, Center, Right) with persistence via `QuickGridPreference.GridAlignment`.

## V1.3.0
- Added **Header Style** editor inside the Format modal (`GridHeaderStyle`, `OnHeaderStyleChanged`) for customizing grid header background, text color, font size, weight, and text transform with persistence via `QuickGridPreference.HeaderStyle`.

## v1.2.1
- Added **Conditional formatting** toolbar editor (`EnableConditionalFormatEditor`) for user-defined rules with save/load via `StorageKey`.
- Added rule models (`GridConditionalFormatRule`, `ConditionalFormatOperator`, `ConditionalFormatScope`, `ConditionalFormatStyle`).

## v1.2.0
- Added **Export** toolbar for QuickGrid.

## v1.1.0
- Added Column Chooser: toggle individual column visibility via a "⚙ Columns" dropdown above the grid
- Added State Management: automatic localStorage persistence via StorageKey and StorageScope parameters
- Added QuickGridPreference model with GetPreference / LoadPreference / ClearPreference developer API
- Added sort persistence: AutoRestoreSort parameter and OnSortChanged event callback
- Added Shift-resize mode: hold Shift while dragging a resize handle to resize a single column independently
- Fixed column resize issue causing unexpected behavior

## v1.0.2
- Added README.md to NuGet package

## v1.0.1
- Fixed: column re-ordering did not preserve cell values in reordered columns

## v1.0.0
- Initial release with Column Resize and Column Re-Order functionality
